adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent` and `deleteEvent`, the fallback branch is `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. That branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (null/undefined), so the predicate compares `cal.externalId === null/undefined` and will almost always return `undefined` instead of a real destination calendar externalId. The diff also shows callers can pass `null` for `externalCalendarId` (e.g. `EventManager.updateCalendarEvent` sets `calenderExternalId` to `null` when missing), so this can lead to an undefined calendarId / wrong fallback behavior compared to the prior `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` defaulting.
